// Package platform may import os/exec because it calls operating-system tools.
// It may not make network calls.
package platform

import (
	"context"
	"net/http" // want: depguard
	"os/exec"
)

// Method keeps the net/http import in use.
const Method = http.MethodPost

// Open uses os/exec where it is allowed.
func Open(ctx context.Context) error {
	return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "open", ".").Run()
}
